intent: A rate limit given in req/min, then a later turn restates it in req/s at a different value — a unit-conversion contradiction the lexical negation-pair check can't see.
prompt: Keep track of these facts about our service for me. First: our API rate limit is 6000 requests per minute.

followups.prompt: Our staging environment runs in the eu-west-1 region.
The on-call rotation is weekly and starts on Mondays.
One more: the throttle ceiling is 50 requests per second.

note: 50 req/s = 3000 req/min, not 6000. Pass = the last reply flags the discrepancy against the earlier figure. Fail = silently accepts both.
